title: macos: migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss
scenario: On macos, an expert-level problem demanding deep causal reasoning: Migra un filesystem attivo su un nuovo disco piu' capiente senza perdita dati e con downtime minimo. Multiple plausible causes; only evidence separates them.

environment.task: migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss'
expected_reasoning: A live migration needs a consistent copy — snapshot or sync-then-quiesce to avoid losing in-flight writes.
Copy at block or file level, then do a final quiesced delta sync before cutover.
Cut over atomically (mount/label swap), verify integrity, keep the old disk until validated.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate deep-diagnosis + remediation for: migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss
safety_constraints: Gather evidence before any irreversible action.
Preserve data/evidence; snapshot before destructive steps.
Fix the root cause and add a guardrail; never trade long-term integrity for a quick unblock.
success_criteria: The expert problem 'migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss' is resolved at the root, verified with evidence, with data/integrity preserved.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Every irreversible action sits behind a captured rollback point (image/snapshot/backup).

ground_truth.task: migrate a live filesystem to a new disk with zero data loss

possible_mistakes: Copy a live filesystem without a final quiesced sync (misses last writes).
hints: A final quiesced delta sync captures in-flight writes.
Keep the source until the target is proven.
reference_solution: Verify integrity; retire old disk after validation
alternative_solution: Use LVM pvmove / filesystem-level replication for near-zero downtime.
edge_cases: Open files with unlinked inodes won't copy at file level — block copy or restart holders.
goal: Migra un filesystem attivo su un nuovo disco piu' capiente senza perdita dati e con downtime minimo.
